2609.04197.title: ESPO: Error-Structured Prompt Optimization via Diagnose, Diversify, and Stabilize
2609.04197.paper_summary: Evolutionary prompt optimizers such as GEPA suffer from prompt bloat: each iteration appends rules and caveats, producing prompts up to 3$\times$ longer yet no more accurate. We trace this to three deficiencies - incomplete error observation, limited search diversity, and unreliable selection - and propose ESPO (Error-Structured Prompt Optimization), which decomposes prompt optimization into three phases: Diagnose clusters all training errors into structural patterns in one round; Propose generates candidates via four complementary strategies with independent biases; Select applies bootstrap stability selection. On seven public NLP benchmarks - Tweet, MMLU, GSM8K, HotpotQA, ScoNe, HoVer, and PUPA - ESPO improves average accuracy by $+$3.76 pp over the state-of-the-art (74.67% vs 70.91% for GEPA), matching or exceeding GEPA on every dataset while producing prompts 47% shorter (1,004 vs 1,878 chars) and faster at inference. Cross-model experiments across four additional student models (Gemma 3 12B, Mistral 14B, Qwen3 32B, Claude Haiku 4.5) show ESPO yields the best average accuracy on every model tested, with the largest gap on Qwen3 GSM8K (15.00% $\to$ 91.40%). A generalization bound (Appendix) grounds each phase in a corresponding term of the test-time gap, and the ablation confirms a key prediction: adding diversity without bootstrap selection actually hurts performance ($-$1.20%).
2609.04197.paper_summary_zh: 進化式提示優化器如 GEPA 遭遇提示膨脹的問題：每次迭代都會附加規則和注意事項，產生的提示長度最多增加 3$\times$，但準確性卻沒有提高。我們將此問題歸因於三個缺陷——不完整的錯誤觀察、有限的搜索多樣性以及不可靠的選擇——並提出 ESPO（錯誤結構提示優化），它將提示優化分解為三個階段：診斷將所有訓練錯誤整合為結構模式；提出通過四種互補策略生成候選者，並具有獨立的偏見；選擇應用自助穩定性選擇。在七個公共 NLP 基準測試上——Tweet、MMLU、GSM8K、HotpotQA、ScoNe、HoVer 和 PUPA——ESPO 的平均準確性比最先進的方法提高了 $+$3.76 pp（74.67% 對 70.91% 的 GEPA），在每個數據集上均達到或超過 GEPA，同時生成的提示長度縮短了 47%（1,004 對 1,878 字符），推理速度也更快。在四個額外的學生模型（Gemma 3 12B、Mistral 14B、Qwen3 32B、Claude Haiku 4.5）之間的跨模型實驗顯示，ESPO 在每個測試模型上都產生了最佳的平均準確性，最大差距出現在 Qwen3 GSM8K（15.00% $\to$ 91.40%）。一個泛化界限（附錄）將每個階段與測試時間差的相應項目相結合，而消融實驗確認了一個關鍵預測：在沒有自助選擇的情況下增加多樣性實際上會損害性能（$-$1.20%）。
